description: Read the latest NEAR AI Cloud TEE snapshot after vet402 re-runs the published NEAR AI Inference SDK verification steps (pinned commit 085a304). Read-only. No API key. Before the first daily run the answer is status no_run_yet with next_run_utc (09:00 UTC) and an empty models list. After a run it lists Gateway keyless ECDSA TLS binding, Intel PCS TDX checks, and NRAS GPU JWKS results for vllm models with attestationSupported. Out-of-date TCB with valid cryptography is advisory (SDK default accepts OutOfDate and TDRelaunchAdvised). Missing GPU evidence is reported as not provided and does not count as a pass. PCCS or NRAS outages are unverified. Two consecutive serious mismatches before fail. It changes no data and has no charge. Up to 30 calls per minute per IP.
name: check_nearai_attestation
title: NEAR AI TEE attestation snapshot
